title: Cardano Corporate PoC Lab - Japan (powered by Antler Ibex)

ms.promise:
Identification and onboarding of 2–3 Japanese financial institutions and/or corporates as potential participants for ideation workshops.
Each participating organization must:
・Assign ≥2 representatives with decision-making authority.
・Commit to ≥2 ideation workshop sessions (total minimum 4 hours).
・Provide a written confirmation specifying their focus area(s) for problem exploration.
・Specify a resource allocation timeframe (e.g., Q1–Q2 2026).

Initial alignment meetings conducted with each confirmed organization to review ideation objectives, confirm participation scope, and align expectations.
Recruitment timeline documented from outreach to confirmation (dates, channels, outcomes).
Outreach activities and follow-ups logged in CRM/spreadsheet (showing at least 10 corporates contacted, ≥2 confirmed).

ms.promise:

Each onboarded corporate must:
・Provide a signed commitment document (MoU, letter, or official email PDF).

・Confirm specific business challenges or focus areas to explore.
・Approve a workshop participation plan (dates, objectives, expected deliverables).

Onboarding package delivered to each corporate, including workshop overview, success criteria, and time/resource commitments.
Conversion funnel documented per corporate (source → touchpoints → decision → confirmation).
